crossRefs.note: The first came out red all over, like a hairy garment. They named him Esau.

people.name: Esau
people.line: Isaac's firstborn son; sold birthright to Jacob; became Edom.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Rebekah
people.line: Wife of Isaac; mother of Jacob and Esau

translations.web: Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, “Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man.
translations.bsb: Jacob answered his mother Rebekah, “Look, my brother Esau is a hairy man, but I am smooth-skinned.
translations.kjv: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man:
translations.asv: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man.
